prediction_demo.purpose: prediction demonstration only; not benchmark metrics

verification.frontend_update_details: frontend.verification; earlier regression entries describe the baseline verification before the frontend update

deferred_minors: The global model selector remains visible on the all-method three-seed results page; it affects prediction and history only.
The demo checksum is read before archive-size rejection; a mistakenly substituted large NPZ can cause extra disk I/O.
Synthetic concurrency fixtures share weights; distinct per-model expectations would strengthen that regression test.

limitations: Existing Support/tests/conftest.py imports lowercase support; frontend tests use --noconftest. Historical tests were case-adapted only in a disposable runtime copy.
Three historical preparation tests remain stopped by the unchanged available-RAM <1 GiB guard. One initial CLI timeout passed on retry. No guard or timeout was relaxed.
